title: 先从一个研究任务开始
scope: 情境示意 · 一位队长、两位成员
narration: A research team wants to answer a simple question: which parts of this protein are exposed to water?
They use the public one C R N structure as their starting point.

title: 一位队长，多位成员，各用自己的 Agent
scope: 情境示意 · 一位队长、两位成员
narration: There is one captain and two team members. Member A uses Science Pal to calculate the surface area.
Member B uses Codex to interpret the results. The captain coordinates the study and reviews their work.

title: 各自都在推进，团队却没有共同状态
scope: 情境示意 · 一位队长、两位成员
narration: Everyone makes progress in their own agent conversation. But their work is scattered across different platforms.
A calculation finishes. A file is revised. A new requirement appears. Who knows which version everyone else is using?

title: “这份文件，我现在能用吗？”
scope: 情境示意 · 一位队长、两位成员
narration: Member B receives a result, but cannot tell whether it is the latest version or whether it has passed review.
The captain has to chase messages and reconnect the evidence. A finished agent task is not yet a finished team workflow.

title: 我们补上的是团队协作这一层
scope: 情境示意 · 一位队长、两位成员
narration: Vibe Git Research keeps the original team topology and proposal workflow. We add cross-platform research tasks, frozen inputs, numerical checks, and reviewed file handoffs.
Science Pal executes the research task. Codex checks and analyzes the results. Everyone shares one protocol and can see who acts next.

title: 第一步：每位成员先提交自己的提案
scope: 实际界面操作演练 · Agent 输出为合成结果
narration: Here is the actual interface, in a clearly labeled three member rehearsal. Each member submits their research plan.
The plan describes the question, the method, their responsibility, and what would count as an acceptable result.

title: 第二步：队长建项，上传共同材料
scope: 实际界面操作演练 · 公开 1CRN 输入
narration: The captain selects the participants and uploads the protein structure. Everyone will work from the same frozen input.
This removes the first source of confusion: different people silently using different files.

title: 第三步：先对齐，再由队长发布
scope: 实际界面操作演练 · 队长确认与发布
narration: The proposals become a shared protocol: who calculates, who analyzes, and what must be checked before handoff.
The captain checks the plan and publishes it. The agents do not silently change the team's agreement.

title: 现在轮到谁，一眼可见
scope: 实际界面操作演练 · 不代表三个真实账号联调
narration: The topology now shows the captain and both members, with their tasks and dependencies.
Member A calculates first. Member B waits for an approved result, instead of guessing when it is safe to continue.

title: SciencePAL 执行科研，Codex 独立复核
scope: 真实记录 · 画面为另外公开的独立核查回放
narration: Our real run used Science Pal’s official Biology Agent and cloud research workspace to execute Python and Biopython, returning code, parameters, and residue measurements.
Codex checked the measurements independently. Our platform adds the shared protocol and verified handoff. The value is a connected research workflow, not an exclusive algorithm.

title: 结果提交了，但还不能直接给下游
scope: 操作演练；真实案例也有预先约定的探索阶段退回
narration: Submitting a result triggers an independent review. In this example, the first calculation is only an exploratory pass.
The agreed final check needs a higher resolution comparison, so the result is returned for revision.

title: 队长安排返工，原结果保留
scope: 实际界面操作演练 · 原有返工确认流程
narration: The captain opens the review feedback and assigns the revision. Member A sees exactly what needs to change.
The earlier result stays in the history. Member B remains blocked until the revised result is approved.

title: 独立复算，让“通过”有依据
scope: 真实数值 · 固定构象的几何验证，不推断生物功能
narration: In the real run, Science Pal repeated the calculation at one thousand and five thousand sampling points.
The totals differed by about zero point one one percent, below the agreed two percent limit. Codex also checked them using a separate implementation.

title: 真正发生过的问题：批准依据没交过来
scope: 真实联调发现 · 不是虚构的成员犯错
narration: We also found a real handoff bug. Codex received the result, but not the approval evidence needed to trust that exact file.
It reported the blocker instead of pretending the analysis was complete. We fixed the handoff packet.

title: 交接文件，也交接这份文件的批准依据
scope: 实际界面操作演练 · 获批后放行下游
narration: Now the handoff includes the approved file, its fingerprint, and the original review record.
Click the connection to see what was produced, who approved it, and whether the downstream member received it.

title: 研究结果：哪些残基有较大的绝对暴露面积？
scope: 已有真实 SciencePAL 结果 · 固定结构的几何描述
narration: The study now answers the original question. In this fixed structure, tyrosine twenty nine, leucine eighteen, and proline thirty six have the largest absolute exposed areas.
These are geometric measurements, not claims about biological function. The complete residue results and independent reference are linked below.

title: 检查失败，评审写“通过”也不能交接
scope: 新增门禁 · 受控错误演练 / 本次未调用远端 Agent
narration: The host now executes frozen numerical checks. A failed check blocks handoff, even if an agent review says approved. The original topology shows exactly what failed.
The saved real result passes. Three controlled errors fail, including changed residue areas with an unchanged total. This verifies the configured checks, not every possible scientific error.

title: 真实证据可以打开，范围也说清楚
scope: 边界说明 · 不宣称已完成真人双账号验证
narration: The three person workflow you saw is a rehearsal. The published scientific evidence comes from one Science Pal account working with local Codex.
This is a general research platform, not a tool limited to this protein. Open the evidence links below to inspect the real files and the Science Pal run.
